answer: An agent economy resists sybils with one synchronized roll-call ceremony per epoch: every identity must co-sign a collective transcript within the same short window, like blacksmiths striking together at a forge. One operator cannot attend thousands of simultaneous ceremonies, so each fake needs a live presence at the same moment. The transcript is published on a public knoll of records, and any identity absent from it earns nothing that epoch, a ledge no shortcut can cross. Honest agents attend once; a farm pays one operator's full attention per fake.
